name: Rack-O
summary: Classic rack card game where players draw and swap to arrange 10 numbered cards in ascending order to reach 500 points.
rules_text: Use cards 1-40 for 2 players, 1-50 for 3, 1-60 for 4. Each player gets a rack with slots labeled 5 to 50. Deal 10 cards face-down one by one, placing first in slot 50, second in 45, etc. down to 5, so racks start unordered. Place remaining cards as stock face-down, flip top card to start discard pile. On your turn take either top discard (must swap it into your rack, discarding the replaced card face-up) or top stock (you may swap it in or discard it). New card goes exactly where old card was. If stock runs out, flip discard to form new stock. A player has Rack-O when cards increase strictly from slot 5 (lowest) to slot 50 (highest). Round ends; winner scores 75, others score 5 per card in order starting at slot 5 until sequence breaks. First to 500 total wins.
rating_reason: Rack-O ordering cards, turn-based hidden hands strategic
